edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the minter/owner inside _mint and controls the minted token ownership.
msg.sender is forwarded directly into the external burn call.
msg.sender is the recipient of _safeMint, triggering an external callback.
block.timestamp determines whether mintTokens proceeds.
Mint window enforcement relies on block.timestamp comparisons.
mintStartTime is compared against block.timestamp.
mintEndTime is compared against block.timestamp.
mintTokens loops and calls _mint for each token id.
_mint performs the external burn call before completing its state updates.
_mint calls _safeMint which performs an external receiver callback.
_mint invokes _ownsParentToken for ownership validation.
mintedSuit is written only after external calls, allowing reentrant reuse of the same suit.
_mint reads _mintPassContractAddress to build the pass instance.
The external burn call can reenter _mint before mintedSuit is set.
The ERC721 receiver callback can reenter _mint before mintedSuit is set.

_ownsParentToken reads the ERC1155 parent contract address.
_ownsParentToken compares against the Wolf Game contract address.
_ownsParentToken uses the Wolf Game staking contract address.
_ownsParentToken performs the external tokenStakes call.
